# Mert Güneþ

> Mechatronics Engineer & AI Specialist based in Istanbul, Turkey.
> Specializing in AI workflows, RAG architectures, local LLM deployment, autonomous mechatronic systems, product & technology management, and full-stack software development.

## Summary & Profile
Mert Güneþ is a technology professional operating at the intersection of Mechatronics Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Product Management. Currently serving as Product & Technology Manager at Alkom Technology, he builds end-to-end autonomous solutions, local document-grounded AI assistants (RAG), automated enterprise workflows, and high-performance web applications.

## Key Capabilities & Technical Stack
- **AI Automation & LLMs**: Local RAG Architectures, OpenAI Whisper v3, Qwen 2.5, Llama 3, Qdrant Vector DB, Ollama, AI Workflows & Automation.
- **Product & Business Tech**: Product & Technology Management, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Process Improvement, Pre-Sales Support, Sourcing & Technical Evaluation, Data Analysis.
- **Mechatronics & Robotics**: Embedded Systems, Control Systems, Sensor Integration, Microcontrollers, SolidWorks, Robotics Kinematics.
- **Full-Stack Software**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, REST APIs, Vercel.

## Professional Experience
- **Product & Technology Manager** @ Alkom Technology (Jan 2026 – Present)
- **Technical Support Engineer** @ DHE Industrial (Aug 2025 – Aug 2026)
- **Operations & Service Engineer** @ Tepe Analitik (Aug 2023 – Mar 2025)

## Education
- **M.Sc. Management Information Systems** @ Marmara University (2025 – 2027)
- **B.Sc. Mechatronics Engineering** @ Istanbul Ticaret University (2018 – 2023, 100% Scholarship)

## Key Projects
- **Personal Portfolio Website**: Modern, high-performance architectural portfolio with dynamic engineering visual systems.
- **Interactive 3D Travel Log**: Three.js & React Three Fiber powered interactive 3D globe visualization.
- **Offline Voice Assistant (RAG)**: Completely air-gapped, on-prem voice assistant using Whisper v3, Qwen 2.5, and Qdrant.
- **Industrial Data Dashboard**: Operational metrics visualization and data-driven reporting system.
- **End-to-End Smart Home Architecture**: Autonomous IoT ecosystem managing 20+ smart home nodes.
- **FabArm 5-DOF Robotic Arm**: 5-axis robotic manipulator with inverse kinematics and mecanum platform.
- **Pulsar Electromobile**: Carbon-fiber electric vehicle chassis engineering for Teknofest Efficiency Challenge.
